links.outcome: AI performance validated across diverse sites and ultrasound systems, reported by center and device
links.effect: Models demonstrated robust performance across centers, ultrasound systems, histological diagnoses and patient age groups, using leave-one-center-out validation across 20 centers.
links.quote: The models demonstrated robust performance across centers, ultrasound systems, histological diagnoses and patient age groups, significantly outperforming both expert and non-expert examiners on all evaluated metrics, namely F1 score, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, Cohen's kappa, Matthew's correlation coefficient, diagnostic odds ratio and Youden's J statistic.

links.outcome: AI diagnostic performance compared with expert and non-expert examiners on same data
links.effect: AI significantly outperformed both expert and non-expert examiners on all evaluated metrics; triage simulation reduced expert referrals by 63% while surpassing current practice.
links.quote: Furthermore, in a retrospective triage simulation, artificial intelligence (AI)-driven diagnostic support reduced referrals to experts by 63% while significantly surpassing the diagnostic performance of the current practice.

screen.reason: Multicenter validation and retrospective triage simulation assessing an AI triage workflow practice to optimize referral rates and diagnostic performance compared to standard clinical practice.

primary.practice: AI-driven triage simulation to reduce expert referrals
